item.description: ### Added - **Perch now tells you when a session needs a restart.** An agent that was already running when Perch installed or updated its hooks never loads them, and until now such a session looked exactly like a healthy idle one. A Claude Code, Cursor or Devin session in that state now shows "Restart to enable live updates" on its row, and one that started after the install but has still sent nothing shows "Hooks not firing" instead, which is the case worth reporting. Settings lists, per provider, when the integration was installed, when it last sent an event, and how many open sessions need a restart. The diagnostics bundle carries the same lines.
